steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. How does a transformer neural network work, conceptually?

steps.action: A transformer processes a sequence by first embedding tokens (plus positional encodings), then passing them through stacked layers of  “self-attention” and feed-forward sublayers. In self-attention, every token computes attention scores against all others to form a weighted sum—this lets the model learn how words relate across the sequence. Multiple “heads” let it capture different relation types in parallel. Each sublayer is wrapped with residual connections and layer normalization. After several such blocks, a final projection layer turns the contextualized vectors into predictions (e.g. next word probabilities in language models).
